title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
contract: Return the largest rectangle area under nonnegative unit-width bars.
brute: long best=0;for(int l=0;l<a.length;l++){int min=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int r=l;r<a.length;r++){min=Math.min(min,a[r]);best=Math.max(best,(long)min*(r-l+1));emit("Use the smallest bar in an interval","range",new int[]{l,r},"height",min,"best",best);}}return best;
optimal: Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();long best=0;for(int i=0;i<=a.length;i++){int height=i==a.length?0:a[i];while(!stack.isEmpty()&&a[stack.peek()]>height){int h=a[stack.pop()],left=stack.isEmpty()?-1:stack.peek();best=Math.max(best,(long)h*(i-left-1));emit("Finalize a rectangle at its first smaller right boundary","height",h,"boundaries",new int[]{left,i},"best",best);}if(i<a.length)stack.push(i);}return best;
reasoning: For every interval, its minimum bar bounds the possible rectangle height.
Maintain nondecreasing bar indices; a smaller incoming height resolves rectangles using popped heights.
After popping, the stack top is the left exclusive boundary and i is the right exclusive boundary. Width is i−left−1. A final zero-height sentinel flushes remaining positive heights.
